description: This is an abstract base class for secret management implementations, defining the interface for reading, writing, deleting, and rotating secrets asynchronously and synchronously. It also provides a default implementation for rotating secrets by creating a new secret and deleting the old one.

classes.name: BaseSecretManager
classes.description: An abstract base class for secret management systems, specifying methods for reading, writing, deleting, and rotating secrets.

methods.description: Asynchronously writes a secret to the secret manager.

methods.name: dict async_delete_secret( self, secret_name: str, recovery_window_in_days: Optional[int] = 7, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, timeout: Optional[Union[float, httpx.Timeout]] = None, )
